_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based solutions, content, and other services to people and businesses; licensing and supporting an array of software products; delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience; and designing and selling devices'; 'Business model competition': 'Our competitors continue to develop and deploy cloud-based services for consumers and business customers' and 'Some companies compete with us by modifying and then distributing open source software at little or no cost to end users'; 'Our focus on cloud-based and AI services presents execution and competitive risks'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may adversely affect our results of operations' (its own FY2024 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: Microsoft's own FY2024 10-K, under 'Business model competition', says 'Our competitors continue to develop and deploy cloud-based services for consumers and business customers, and pricing and delivery models are evolving.', and under 'Our focus on cloud-based and AI services presents execution and competitive risks.', 'These costs will reduce the operating margins.' It competes with cloud services of its own: 'We and our competitors are devoting significant resources to develop and deploy our cloud-based strategies.' The stock trades at 36.3x FY25E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of Microsoft's licensed software specifically.

Live: Microsoft's own FY2024 10-K, under 'Business model competition', says 'We expect AI technology and services to be a highly competitive and rapidly evolving market, and new competitors continue to enter the market.' and that some companies compete with it 'using open source AI models' ('Some open source products mimic the features and functionality of our products.') It sells generative AI of its own: 'We are investing in artificial intelligence (“AI”) across the entire company and infusing generative AI capabilities into our consumer and commercial offerings.' The stock trades at 36.3x FY25E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing generative-AI substitution of Microsoft's software seats or search specifically.

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based solutions, content, and other services to people and businesses; licensing and supporting an array of software products; delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience; and designing and selling devices'; 'Business model competition': 'Our competitors continue to develop and deploy cloud-based services for consumers and business customers' and 'Some companies compete with us by modifying and then distributing open source software at little or no cost to end users'; 'Our focus on cloud-based and AI services presents execution and competitive risks'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may adversely affect our results of operations' (its own FY2024 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 3.58x; +81% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.97; conservative 2yr -11%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.7%/yr (worst year FY15-FY24, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +17.1%/yr (Q4 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +18.2%/yr (FY15-FY24 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +29.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY24); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2024-09-27) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 3.58x (53.5% downside to Bear $199 / +14.9% upside to Bull $492) | Adj composite 2.39 vs market 3.36: gap -0.97 [OVERVALUED] | +81% above the EPP floor $236 (20x FY25E $11.80) | Conservative 2-yr case: -10.9% total (-5.4%/yr) | At 36.3x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $566 sits above the BULL case; unearned revenue +11.8% in Q4 FY24, forward revenues +16% (no Q1 FY25 revenue guide, Q4 FY24 revenue ex-currency); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
